title: Total synthesis of natural products facilitated by prins reaction: a review

The Prins reaction is a valuable synthetic strategy that enables C–C bond formation, leading to the construction of key core structures in natural products such as tetrahydropyrans, dihydropyrans, and spirocyclic ethers.
